text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup.
Tokyo Racecourse was trembling with excitement.
(Waaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The winner's gotta be Orfevre!
No one else could be the King!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She really is the strongest Umamusume right now, after all!
Lady Orfevre~! Keep stacking up those golden victories!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Sure, Gentildonna might be the best on the Tiara route...
but going against a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume is another story.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ms. Gentildonna...
Even so, you will... surely――"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I understand everyone's predictions.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Because you must be considering it based on the data so far, as well as rules of thumb.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: The fact is, no Umamusume has ever won the Japan Cup after claiming victory in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"An ordinary Umamusume
might end up having a typical year, yes."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There is no past that can stand beside me.
And likely, not even in the future.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: In a single instant, this power—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Because we can change the world.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
Care to give me some race advice?
choice_data_list: ...Try not to overthink things with Orfe.

text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, she'll be the biggest rival today.
Their skills are evenly matched... No, in terms of experience,
Gentildonna might be slightly at a disadvantage.

“However, if Gentildonna puts everything she has
into it, all of her strength...
she will definitely win!”
choice_data_list: Hit them with 120% of what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure it's alright for me to give 120%?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I might end up
breaking everyone...
choice_data_list: Today's opponent won't be a pushover.
Today's opponent won't be easy to beat, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Why, that is...
more than I could ever hope for.
choice_data_list: Go out there and give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are truly sure about this, yes?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Even I cannot predict
what might happen, you know.

The atmosphere around Gentildonna shifts.
This is her at full power, giving 120%...!
In that case—
choice_data_list: ...I don't mind. I'll take full responsibility!
...I don't mind. I'll take full responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Well then—I shall be on my way.
"Could it be that I've awakened something terrible in her...? ...I immediately dismissed the thought."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're here...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san!
Gentil-san is here!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san, Flash-san. Good day to you both.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for having me today.
Here's to a good race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Lame.
Thought they'd pick more of a fight.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What she is most conscious of today is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"König...
A single king—I presume."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How are you doing today,
Orfe-san?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do you recall?
Back during the summer, I was dreadfully rude to you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You scolded me, saying that
I was not good enough as I am."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to
formally introduce myself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is an honor
to stand before the King.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Please be sure to remember
this current me very well, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—I do not know the words to honor the defeated.
So savor this while you still can.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I hear nothing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The buzzing of gnats cannot reach We.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. Even after all this,
I still haven't earned your displeasure, have I?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Then by brute force.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing the expression
on your face once today is over.
